課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Introduction to Electrical and Computer Engineering
課程綱要.課程目標: 請參閱英文說明 This course provides undergraduate students with a comprehensive overview of the field of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE). The primary objective is to help students understand the current status and future trends of contemporary ECE disciplines, while fostering practical connections with industry. Students will gain a foundational understanding of core areas, including electrical engineering, computer science, communications, and networking, as well as insights into the development of related technologies and industries.
課程綱要.授課內容:
請參閱英文說明
Introduction to Electrical Engineering
- Basic principles and applications
- Power systems, electronics, devices, and control systems
Introduction to Computer Science
- Programming, algorithms, and data structures
- Artificial intelligence and computer systems
Introduction to Communications Engineering
- Fundamentals of signal transmission and processing
- Wireless communication and emerging technologies
Introduction to Networking Engineering
- Network architecture, protocols, and security
- Cloud computing and Internet of Things (IoT)
Current Developments in ECE-Related Technologies and Industries
- Semiconductor industry and hardware innovations
- Software-driven transformation and AI applications
Industry case studies and guest lectures

課程綱要.彈性教學說明: Supplementary learning materials will be provided for students to support self-study
